title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey everyone, sorry for the wait!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great job on the livestream, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We all watched it together. You really nailed that dance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The moment you finished, we all gave you a standing ovation!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was wonderful, Minori! Your moves were looking so polished!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Although at one point, you waved the wrong arm, and then there was the part where you spun and lost your balance...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but technically the spin doesn't count as a mistake, even though you didn't quite pull it off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Which means...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes!
The result of the challenge is a big...

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Pass!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Well done, Minori!>
<Whoa!>
<You did it! Congratulations!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, here's to Minori's birthday, and completing the Special Birthday Challenge to boot!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Minori. We brought lots of snacks, so help yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I won't hold back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, while you all dig in, we have an announcement!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's time for part two of the Special Birthday Segment—the Minori Mastermind Showdown!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Minori... Mastermind?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What? That sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a game to see who knows the most about Minori!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whoever answers the questions most like Minori wins a point!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is a team versus team game, so I'll announce those now. Make sure you come up with your team name.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, now everyone's decided on a team name, it's time for round one. Let the Minori Mastermind Showdown commence!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Introducing Airi and Shizuku from team MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seeming that we practically raised her ourselves, there's no doubt we've got this in the bag!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, do me proud.
Alright, and team two is Kohane and Hinomori from team Class 1-A!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As Minori's classmates, we'll give this our all!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Moving onto the final team, we have Hoshino, Tenma, Mochizuki, and Otori from team Firey Friends!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As your friends, we refuse to lose to the other teams!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And last but not least, the one answering the questions—Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi! I have to say, I'm surprised you planned this much for my birthday. I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, without further ado, it's time for question one: what's Minori's catchphrase?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This one's easy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Easy! It's gotta be this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seems that every team has an answer. Alright everyone, including Minori, it's time to reveal your answers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... I think the answer would be, “More and more and more!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew, we got the same answer!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All three teams get a point! You truly are good friends of hers, but this next one calls for your deductive skills.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Question two: what does Minori want to eat for dinner today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What I want to eat for dinner today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You should just go with your gut instinct on this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! We had lunch together today, so this one's a free win for us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, seeing everyone read so much into me is making me blush.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because everyone here loves you so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now this time, let's go round the teams in order, starting with team Fiery Friends since you're so confident.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪ Our answer is...steak!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we ate lunch with Minori today, she told us that she had fish for dinner last night, so she wants to have meat today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, it sounds like we're on the right track, too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Class 1-A Team has...Salisbury steak.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When I mentioned that I had Salisbury steak last night, she appeared enticed by the idea of having it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... Both options seem very likely. Finally, team MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We think it's birthday cake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only because it's her birthday today, but let's just say she's as spontaneously strange as Shizuku at times like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seems that every team has a solid answer, but what does Minori think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... I'm sorry everyone! The meal I want to have for dinner today is...crab cream croquettes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Minori! So what was with all that talk about meat?! At least stick to the narrative or go with cake if you insist on an unusual answer!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? But hey, I was told to just go with my gut feeling!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hanasato. Ena and I watched your livestream together on Nightcord. Congratulations on passing the dance challenge.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Minori, when you finished dancing, I immediately started clapping because I knew you passed. You truly are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. Um... I'm sure you've heard this a lot already, but good luck on your idol journey. You have my support.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Minori! Happy, happy, happy birthday to you♪ Take it away, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Happy, happy, happy birthday!
Um... Ena told me about the party you had at school.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's times like this that I wish we were at the same school. Let's celebrate together at singing practice. Have a wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Minori! The party was sooo fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. If we do this again, I'll aim to become the master of all things Minori!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. We managed to get a handful of them right, but the rest set us on a losing streak.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, there's no way we could have gotten those ones right. Kohane and I were in the same boat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Hey An, that quiz really gave us an insight into Minori's mind and the sort of things she likes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Sounds interesting! I guess I'll just have to sneak into Miya Girls for round two!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Minori, I hope you had an amazing day! Feel free to stop by Weekend Garage with Haruka and the others sometime. I'll make sure to prepare a special treat for you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Minori.
I'm glad everyone enjoyed the Minori Mastermind Showdown.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well in the end, all three teams tied so there was no winner...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's because I thought your team had a pretty big advantage, so I decided to slip in some questions that required a sheer good luck.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I gotta admit, the difficulty was just right...but there's no way we were going to get the crab cream croquettes one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, tell me about it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday Minori. And nice job during the livestream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to growing more as idols together. Let's give it our all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for making today so memorable for me. This is probably the most I've celebrated my birthday in my entire life!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to do what I can to continue to grow alongside your support—both as an idol and a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I, Minori Hanasato, vow to give everyone more and more and more hope than ever before!
